questions.stem: In a quadrilateral, what is the name of the line segment that connects the opposite vertices?
questions.solution: A diagonal is a line segment that connects two non-adjacent vertices of a quadrilateral. A side connects adjacent vertices, an angle is formed where two sides meet at a vertex, and a vertex is a point where sides meet. Therefore, the correct answer is diagonal.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct definition of a triangle?
choices: A shape formed by joining three non-collinear points
A shape with four sides and three angles
A shape formed by joining three collinear points
questions.solution: A triangle is a shape formed by joining three non-collinear points because this creates a closed figure with three sides and three angles. A shape with four sides or angles cannot be a triangle, as it would be a different polygon. Joining collinear points would result in a straight line, not a triangle.

questions.stem: If a triangle has one angle of 135°, what type of triangle is it?
questions.solution: A triangle with an angle greater than 90° but less than 180° is classified as obtuse-angled. An equilateral triangle has all angles equal to 60°, an isosceles triangle has two equal angles but not necessarily an obtuse angle, and an acute-angled triangle has all angles less than 90°. A 135° angle is greater than 90°, making the triangle obtuse-angled.

hi.stem: यदि एक त्रिभुज का एक कोण 135° है, तो यह किस प्रकार का त्रिभुज है?
hi.solution: 90° से अधिक लेकिन 180° से कम कोण वाले त्रिभुज को अधिककोण त्रिभुज कहा जाता है। एक समबाहु त्रिभुज में सभी कोण 60° के होते हैं, एक समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज में दो समान कोण होते हैं लेकिन आवश्यक नहीं कि एक अधिककोण हो, और एक न्यूनकोण त्रिभुज में सभी कोण 90° से कम होते हैं। 135° का कोण 90° से अधिक है, इसलिए त्रिभुज अधिककोण त्रिभुज है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, technical terms are standard in Hindi textbooks, and the logic of the solution matches the original.

questions.stem: In a triangle, the sum of the measures of any two angles is 120°. What is the measure of the third angle?
questions.solution: The sum of the angles in a triangle is always 180°. If the sum of two angles is 120°, the third angle must be 180° - 120° = 60°. The other options are incorrect because 90° and 120° do not satisfy the angle sum property of a triangle, and 180° would make the triangle degenerate.

hi.solution: त्रिभुज में कोणों का योग हमेशा 180° होता है। यदि दो कोणों के मापों का योग 120° है, तो तीसरा कोण 180° - 120° = 60° होना चाहिए। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि 90° और 120° त्रिभुज के कोण योग गुण को संतुष्ट नहीं करते, और 180° त्रिभुज को डिजनरेट बना देगा।

mr.stem: त्रिकोणात, कोणत्याही दोन कोनांच्या मापांची बेरीज 120° आहे. तिसऱ्या कोनाचे माप किती आहे?

mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate terminology used in Marathi textbooks.

questions.solution: A triangle with all three sides of equal length is defined as an equilateral triangle. A right-angled triangle has one 90-degree angle, an isosceles triangle has only two equal sides, and an acute-angled triangle has all angles less than 90 degrees. Therefore, the correct answer is equilateral.

questions.stem: In a triangle, if two angles are 45 degrees each, what is the measure of the third angle?
questions.solution: The sum of the angles in a triangle is always 180 degrees. If two angles are 45 degrees each, the third angle is 180 - 45 - 45 = 90 degrees. The other options do not satisfy the triangle angle sum property.
